title: Spectral interval
description:
A spectral scan over a depth interval, with the mineral or geounit abundances it resolved.

xyz_to.description: Desurveyed position at `depth_to`, as `[x, y, z]` on the project local grid in metres. Null when the hole has no survey.

items.description: Nested abundance row — geounit code/label/color + the cell value.
